name: @imswarnil/swarnil-design
description: Swarnil Design System — a token-first, dependency-free CSS design system for people who make things: web, and the broadcast layer for thumbnails, scenes and streams. Almost monochrome, so one colour can mean something.

scripts.build: npm run css && npm run docs
scripts.css: postcss src/index.css -o dist/swarnil-design.css && postcss src/index.css -o dist/swarnil-design.min.css --env production && postcss src/broadcast.css -o dist/swarnil-broadcast.css && postcss src/broadcast.css -o dist/swarnil-broadcast.min.css --env production && postcss src/framework.css -o dist/swarnil-framework.css && postcss src/framework.css -o dist/swarnil-framework.min.css --env production
scripts.dev: npm run docs && python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory site
scripts.size: for f in dist/swarnil-design.min.css dist/swarnil-broadcast.min.css dist/swarnil-framework.min.css; do printf '%s  ' $f; gzip -c $f | wc -c | awk '{printf "gzipped: %.1f KB\n", $1/1024}'; done
